milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box because sprint-jumping is a movement/traversal task. The player must sprint-jump across a 3-block gap (x=10-12 is air) to reach the east platform starting at x=13. Regular jumps cover ~2.5 blocks and cannot clear this gap. The dependency graph was restructured so sprint-jumping only gates the east branch, making this single-direction check correct.

Uses inventory_has because mining jungle_wood drops the jungle_wood block item into the player's inventory. Jungle wood is placed at (3,0-2,3) near spawn. Player starts with 0 jungle_wood and has a wooden_axe to break it.
Uses inventory_has because mining an acacia_trapdoor drops the trapdoor item into the player's inventory. The trapdoor is at (-3,0,2) near spawn and can be broken by hand or with any tool.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and visually observe the target. The mossy_stone_brick_slab is at (15,0,0) on the east platform. max_distance=3 ensures the player must be ON the east platform (central platform edge at x=9 is 6+ blocks away, so this cannot be triggered without crossing the gap). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the slab.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require visual observation. The brown_concrete_powder is at (-15,0,0) on the west platform. max_distance=3 ensures the player must be ON the west platform (central platform edge at x=-9 is 6+ blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require visual observation. The red_banner is at (17,0,0) on the east platform (placed at y=0 standing on floor at y=-1). max_distance=3 ensures the player walked deeper onto the platform past the slabs. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require visual observation. The purple_carpet is at (-16,0,1) on the west platform. max_distance=3 ensures the player is on the platform. facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual observation.

Uses inventory_has as a documented proxy for bread consumption. Player starts with 0 bread; the bread chest on the east platform at (17,0,1) contains 3 bread. Having at least 1 bread in inventory confirms the player navigated to the remote platform and accessed the chest. This detects chest access rather than literal consumption, accepted as the best available detection method since bread leaves no byproduct when eaten.

Uses inventory_has checking for 'bowl' because eating mushroom_stew consumes the stew and returns an empty bowl to the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 bowls, and the only source of bowls in this scene is consuming the mushroom_stew from the west platform chest at (-17,0,0). Having a bowl definitively proves the player consumed the mushroom stew.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_sign places it in the player's inventory. Recipe: 6 dark_oak_planks + 1 stick = 3 dark_oak_signs. Materials available in supply chest at (-1,0,-3). Player starts with 0 dark_oak_signs.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_helmet places it in the player's inventory. Recipe: 5 iron_ingots in helmet pattern. Player must first smelt iron_ore (5 in supply chest) in the furnace at (1,0,-3) using coal to produce iron_ingots, then craft at the crafting_table. Player starts with 0 iron_helmets.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden_apple places it in the player's inventory. Recipe: 8 gold_ingots surrounding 1 apple in crafting grid. Both materials are in the supply chest at (-1,0,-3). Player starts with 0 golden_apples. This is the final convergence task in the dependency graph.
